_comment: Human annotation schema for identity leadership papers. Fill every field; use null only when the information is genuinely absent from the paper.

research_design._comment: Fill only for empirical papers; null for theoretical/review.
research_design.study_type: <cross-sectional | longitudinal | experimental | RCT | meta-analysis | qualitative | other | null>
research_design.data_collection: <survey | interview | observation | secondary | experiment | other | null>

sample._comment: Per study if multiple studies; use the main/combined sample.

constructs._comment: List every measured/manipulated construct. type: IL=identity leadership, SI=social identity, leadership, individual, group, other.

theoretical_framework: <e.g. Social Identity Theory, Identity Leadership Model, Self-Categorization Theory>
notes: <anything ambiguous, unusual, or worth flagging for LLM comparison>
